author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_adt_lower.rs::{divergence_deposit_certifies_l0_not_oracle_l3, divergence_is_circle_certifies_l0_not_oracle_l3, divergence_sum_list_certifies_l0_not_l3} demonstrate the divergence. ROOT CAUSE: check::item_subprogram (forge/src/check.rs) Item::Fn arm weaves spec_items (SpecFn) + fn_deps (Fn) but NEVER the Item::Struct/Item::Enum declarations the fn signature/body references. The Item::Struct|Enum arm's comment ('Dead-in-1a ... dies at the validator gate SpecError::UnsupportedAdt') is STALE — ADTs now lower (Stage 1c). Per-item lowering of deposit/is_circle/sum_list emits Verus referencing Account/Shape/List with NO decl woven -> verus E0425 'cannot find type' -> level_from_summary degrades to L0. Oracle (conformance/{bank_account,shape}.cert.json) says L3. Fix is the ADT-type-dependency analog of #52: weave reachable struct/enum decls (and their well_formed invariant) into item_subprogram. Note adt_lower_conformance PASSES because it lowers the WHOLE program once; the real forge-check per-item path does not.
